179:    Convert :class:`datetime.datetime` into Thai date and time format.

181:    The formatting directives are similar to :func:`datatime.strrftime`.
182:
183:    This function uses Thai names and Thai Buddhist Era for these directives:
184:        * **%a** - abbreviated weekday name
185:        (i.e. "จ", "อ", "พ", "พฤ", "ศ", "ส", "อา")
186:        * **%A** - full weekday name
187:        (i.e. "วันจันทร์", "วันอังคาร", "วันเสาร์", "วันอาทิตย์")
188:        * **%b** - abbreviated month name
189:        (i.e. "ม.ค.", "ก.พ.", "มี.ค.", "เม.ย.", "พ.ค.", "มิ.ย.", "ธ.ค.")
190:        * **%B** - full month name
191:        (i.e. "มกราคม", "กุมภาพันธ์", "พฤศจิกายน", "ธันวาคม",)
192:        * **%y** - year without century (i.e. "56", "10")
193:        * **%Y** - year with century (i.e. "2556", "2410")
194:        * **%c** - date and time representation
195:        (i.e. "พ   6 ต.ค. 01:40:00 2519")
196:        * **%v** - short date representation
197:        (i.e. " 6-ม.ค.-2562", "27-ก.พ.-2555")
198:    """

202:    fmt_len = len(fmt)
203:    while i < fmt_len:
